title: 三二七號是我
mood: seven unlucky years, one loud night
subject: a customer-service rep who finally wins the top prize at her company's eighties-themed annual-party lucky draw after seven years of 'thanks for taking part'
caption: 1980s mainland Chinese disco revival in the Zhang Qiang dance-hall style. An octave-jumping slap electric bass on every eighth note; DX7-style FM brass stabs and a bell-toned FM electric piano; a bright string pad sweeping up into each chorus; a chicken-scratch clean guitar on the sixteenths; syndrum and tom fills at the ends of phrases; drums with a four-on-the-floor kick, an open hi-hat on every offbeat and handclaps on two and four. Bright, slightly thin 1980s cassette sound, mid-range forward, the bass and the voice up front with a light plate reverb. Female voice, bright, sweet and a little nasal, with a quick vibrato and a teasing, playful delivery; a group of mixed office voices shouting the short answers. 122 BPM, D major. Seven unlucky years, one loud night. No Y2K eurodance, no Japanese city pop chords, no trap drums, no modern EDM drop, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - short, slap bass octaves, FM brass stab, handclaps]

[Verse 1]
公司年會 今年主題是八〇年代
經理穿了喇叭褲 前台戴著一副大眼鏡
我坐最後一桌 離廁所最近那一桌
七年了 我抽到的 都是謝謝參與

[Pre-Chorus]
一等獎 是一台雙開門的大冰箱
老闆把手伸進紅箱子 攪了好久好久

[Chorus]
三二七號 是我 (嘿!)
三二七號 是我是我
我踩著高跟鞋 從廁所旁邊衝上台
整個宴會廳都在喊 (三二七!)

[Verse 2]
老闆說 得獎的人要陪他跳一支舞
燈球開始轉 DJ放了一首迪斯科
我拉著老闆轉了三圈 他的假髮歪到一邊
台下的同事 全部舉著手機在拍

[Pre-Chorus]
冰箱太大 我家根本放不下
我說沒關係 先搬到我們客服部

[Chorus]
三二七號 是我 (嘿!)
三二七號 是我是我
七年的謝謝參與 今天一次還給我
明年年會 我要坐第一桌 (第一桌!)

[Outro - FM brass and string pad, handclaps fading]
冰箱放在客服部 門上貼了我的名字
誰要喝冰可樂 先叫我一聲姐 (姐!)
